gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-nobile: Galaxy runs its strokes at a single width, so even the thin joins hold as firm as the stems. Nobile follows in a plain sans with caps barely taller than lowercase and open, chalk-arc mouths that keep a page moving easily.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-nokora: Approachable and glowing, Galaxy draws neon-tube letters. Nokora follows in a sans with a thick, dark stripe of lowercase and an s that never tightens, so the loose heading gets a grounded partner below.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Noto Kufi Arabic keeps a welcoming gap in its c and holds capitals just above the lowercase. Noto Kufi Arabic is the quiet partner here, a plain sans that lets Galaxy's loose, shade-free letters carry the drama.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads big and friendly, its lowercase filling most of the letter height with a wide-open c. And Galaxy above it gives every stroke the same visual weight, so the sans-serif text feels like a steady follow-up.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Wire-cut and wide. Noto Sans Adlam answers with curve endings kept well apart and c, s and z standing tall and full, a plain sans that holds its own against Galaxy's cosmic spacing.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Galaxy's brush-like single stroke never changes width. Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined gives that a plain sans partner, with generous gaps where curves meet stems and cases close in height.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Galaxy is all dense, loosely spaced lowercase, with no thick and thin parts anywhere. And Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs does the quiet work, a plain sans with outward-pointing terminals and an x-height rising close to cap height.
gen-dafont-galaxy-gf-noto-sans-arabic: Galaxy brings a cosmic, shade-free look, its letters loose and dense. Noto Sans Arabic follows with wide openings on small letters and a pronounced x-height, so a slightly smaller size will still read clearly.
